author: Yffe
content: Failing test at thermite-syntax/tests/divergence_grammar.rs::divergence_if_else_in_tail_position_is_expr. Input `{ if x==0 {1} else {2} }` yields Block{stmts:[Stmt::If..], tail:None} instead of tail Some(Expr::If). parse_block unconditionally routes TokKind::If to parse_if_stmt; the value-position if-expr (surface-grammar.md decision 2, ast.md REQ-6) is never built. The fn body has no value.
